ho2: This is Zarautz Weightlifting Team's web!
gb1: The Weightlifting section of Zarautz Kirol Elkartea welcomes you!
gb2: To sign up with us or get more information, come to our trainings, use the contact form or send an email. JOIN US!
gb3: The weightlifting section of the Zarautz Sports Club (ZKE Halterofilia) has the objective of promotion and encourage the practice of weightlifting in Zarautz since its foundation in 1968.
gb6: We currently carry out our activity, training and most competitions in Gipuzkoa in the weightlifting gymnasium of the Aritzbatalde sports center. Here is the location:
h1: It has been long since Emilio Olazabal created the Zarautz Sports Club on 1943. Some years later, on 1967, he would create a new section in Gipuzkoa: Weightlifting.
h2: He completed the necessary procedures with the Spanish Weightlifting Federation and founded the Weightlifting Federation of Gipuzkoa, becoming the first president. He founded the Basque Weightlifting Federation in 1981, also becoming its president until 1984. Overall, he worked 17 years as president of the Federation of Gipuzkoa and another 3 years as head of the Basque. Thanks to Emilio Olazabal, we were able to watch closely european weightlifting star such as the world recocrd holder belgian Reding or the french Terme.
h3: He worked hard during his whole life to give  culture and sport the place they deserved. He used to say his famous saying in front of the microphone during championships:
h4: “This lifter with their lift, lifts up our Basque Country.”
h5: Some of Emilio Olazabal's actions resumed:
zs1: The Zarautz Award is an individual and team championship organized by ZKE's weightlifting club that takes place at the seaside walk of Zarautz,  and the “Zarautz Award” is given to the winning team. Nowadays, between the classic championships that take place in the Basque Country, it is said to be the most important, and high level weighlifters compete there.
zs2: The Zarautz Award is tied to basque culture. Weightlifting has a close relationship with popular local sports, and in order to improve this relationship, those sports (popularly called “herri kirolak”) have a big presence in the Zarautz Award.
zs4: Since 1968, us who have been around the sport have tried to show it every year to both local and foreign people, using this summer championship as a tool for that. We have had weightlifting in Zarautz since 1968, and started showcasing it in the year 1969, in the competition “1er trofeo Pais Vasco”, organized by ZKE and the Federation of Gipuzkoa at the Zinema fronton of Zarautz. There, aside from local selections' weightlifters, there were also french and belgian weightlifters, amongst them was Reding, the world level record holder. he came as far as 3 times to this competition.
zs5: In 1974, this championship was moved to Musika plaza (a local square) and renamed as “Trofeo Internacional de Halterofilia” (“International Weightlifting Trophy”). Further ahead was renamed as “Manuel Grijalba Memorial” and this championship's last edition was celebrated in 1996 at the local sports center. Those last years Zarautz came to have two weightlifting clubs from 1994 to 1996, although nowadays only remains the club created by the ZKE that has been active for more than 50 years. This club has organized the Zarautz Award since 1992. It is a competition organized only by ZKE, and there the local club competes every year against other teams. In 2002 this competition took place at the Zinema fronton in honor of Emilio Olazabal.
zs6: There have been several weightlifter, local or foreign, that have competed in the Zarautz Award, and nobody forgets about this experience. The winners of this award have come from different places: Asturias, Zaragoza, Girondins from Bordeaux eta also the local ZKE 6 times.
